A1.justification: Both PDFs describe RankOOD and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices. Renumbered tables and relocated analyses can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original RankOOD detection results, training analyses, and hyperparameter ablations, including detailed per-dataset results in the appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds comparisons across training objectives and scoring functions, plus computational measurements.

M1.justification: The core model and CE-plus-ListMLE training remain unchanged. Appendix A.4 introduces and times a greedy alternative to ILP rank assignment. Equations 5–6 also correct the written scoring specification; the PDFs do not establish that the retained benchmark experiments used a changed implementation.

E1.justification: v2 adds ImageNet-1k to computational scaling measurements in Table 4, without reporting OOD detection accuracy there. Existing ID datasets and near-/far-OOD datasets remain unchanged. Replacing ImageNet-200 with TinyImageNet in appendix labels does not establish different data.

E2.justification: The benchmark comparator set is unchanged. Relative to v1's MSP-based training/scoring study, v2 Figure 6 adds MaxLogit, Energy/EBO, GEN, and CE-trained RankOOD-S to that comparison. Table 4 additionally compares exact and greedy rank-assignment runtimes.

E3.justification: v2 adds a crossed comparison of CE versus RankOOD-T with five scoring functions and a protocol reporting per-epoch training and per-class assignment times. Existing splits, AUROC/FPR95 metrics, ResNet-18 backbone, training budgets, optimizer, and rank subsets remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix A.3 extends the existing training-versus-scoring analysis across five scores and two ID datasets. Appendix A.4 adds computational scaling and exact-versus-greedy runtime analyses. The original rank-subset, loss-weight, threshold, and conditional-rank analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions specify means and standard deviations over three independent runs with different seeds. Retained uncertainty reporting is unchanged; v2 introduces no additional repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All matched benchmark entries in Tables 2–3 and v1 Tables 4–11/v2 Tables 5–12 are unchanged. New Figure 6 reports additional results, including CIFAR-10 RankOOD-S AUROC of 87.51 under CE versus 91.70 under RankOOD-T. New Table 4 reports training and assignment runtimes.

T1.justification: Equation 5 corrects the mismatch count to compare expected and predicted labels at the same rank j, and Equation 6 explicitly indexes logits by canonical class. v2 also revises the illustrative RPM values and adds ILP/greedy complexity claims. No theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: canonical class rankings, ListMLE-based training without auxiliary outliers, and strong near-/far-OOD performance, including the claimed 4.3% TinyImageNet FPR95 reduction. Naming the stages RankOOD-T and RankOOD-S does not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: v2 newly attributes the primary gains to RankOOD-T rather than the scoring function and argues that conventional scores can perform comparably after this training. Appendix A.4 adds discussion of training overhead and ILP scaling, proposing greedy assignment as mitigation.

D1.justification: Appendix A.4 newly documents per-epoch GPU times, per-class ILP/greedy runtimes, and approximate comparator epoch counts. Appendix A.5 supplies worked scoring calculations. Existing training hyperparameters remain unchanged; hardware and the greedy procedure are not specified in sufficient detail for reproduction.

R1.justification: The same 48 references and substantive related-work discussion are retained. Positioning relative to ExCeL and CRAFT, including the claimed avoidance of architectural changes and additional fine-tuning, remains the same.

P1.justification: v2 introduces RankOOD-T/RankOOD-S terminology, edits wording and author information, adds appendix subsections, and moves the acknowledgment after the references. Most existing prose and the main section sequence are retained.

P2.justification: v2 adds runtime Table 4, scoring-comparison Figure 6, and worked-example Figure 7. The original conditional-probability Figure 6 becomes Figure 8 and moves to the appendix's final page. Appendix headings, table numbering, and some sizing change; original plots remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The added scoring ablation and runtime measurements improve attribution and cost transparency, while corrected scoring indices clarify implementation. These gains are limited by errors in new material: A.3's claimed minimum 1.5% AUROC improvement exceeds some Figure 6 differences, and Figure 7 reports 28 where Equation 6 with the stated unit weights gives approximately -52.01. These localized errors temper, but do not outweigh, the useful added evidence and corrections.
